name: Wall Angel

instructions.description: Stand with your back against a wall and feet slightly away from it.
Place your arms against the wall in a goalpost position as much as comfortable.
Slide the arms upward and downward slowly while keeping the ribs controlled and the neck relaxed.
Step away from the wall to rest before repeating.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a pain-free range that supports upright posture.

variations.variationDescription: Closely related wall-based shoulder mobility drill with more emphasis on posture and scapular control.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Perform lying down to reduce standing posture demands.

commentsNotes: Do not force every contact point to stay glued to the wall.
